children.name: Introductory Core Courses
children.desc: This introductory course must be taken for five (5) units.

children.name: Five elective courses approved by the Faculty Director
children.desc:
Electives may be selected from many offerings in various disciplines according to student interests, but they must follow a coherent course of study. The Undergraduate Faculty Director must approve this course of study and elective courses.
Courses are relevant to the major in departments across the university, including English, East Asian Studies, History, Religious Studies, Music, Comparative Literature, German, French, Italian, Iberian and Latin American Cultures, Slavic Languages and Literatures, and Classics.

• Up to five units may be taken in a medieval language, such as (but not limited to) Old English, Old Norse, Medieval Latin, Old French, Middle High German, and Classical Arabic.

• Appropriate courses offered through BOSP may count toward this minor
children.notes: The pre-listed courses here are recommended electives but not required. Additional courses must be approved by the Faculty Director.

grading: All courses must be taken for a letter grade.
policies: Coursework may not duplicate work counted toward other majors or minors.
transferPolicy: No transfer or AP credit will be accepted for this minor.
reviewNotes: The audit checks one introductory core course (HISTORY 115D, ENGLISH 131 or ENGLISH 184X) taken for 5 units, five more elective courses, every course letter graded, and the minor's 25 units in all. The electives are a coherent course of study the Undergraduate Faculty Director approves, so you move them in yourself; the listed electives are only suggestions. Checked by hand: each course is 3 units or more, and at most 5 units are in a medieval language. Courses may not also count toward another major or minor, and transfer or AP credit is not accepted.
